fact: The Mauritius Revenue Authority states that VAT charged or collected by foreign digital-service suppliers must be remitted electronically to the MRA, and lists online VAT registration, electronic submission of VAT returns and electronic payment of VAT due as available facilities from 1 January 2026.

The Mauritius Revenue Authority announces the Individual Income Tax Returns e-Filing Season 2025, in which taxpayers file returns electronically with a User Id (NID, NCID or TAN) and password and pay any tax due by 15 October 2025.

The Mauritius Judiciary says registered online users of the e-Judiciary system can top up their account, used for court filing fees, by credit card (module implemented 28 February 2022) and by MauCAS QR code or account transfer (from 23 October 2023).

The TradeNet portal page of Mauritius Network Services says commercial banks are linked to it, enabling electronic payment of duties and taxes, and a 10 March 2025 notice says electronic payment instructions are processed on it.
